source_title: Ministry of Defence seeks development partner to create new intergenerational neighbourhood in Feltham - London Borough of Hounslow
source_excerpt:
The trailblazing partnership between the Ministry of Defence (MoD), Hounslow Council and the Greater London Authority (GLA) takes next step towards start on site.
The MoD today launched a procurement process to find a development partner to develop its 12.1-hectare site just off Feltham High Street.
The vision is to create an intergenerational neighbourhood with new homes, employment space, community facilities, and green infrastructure, bringing investment into Feltham while creating jobs, opportunities, and visible benefits for local people. It will be one of West London’s most ambitious regeneration projects.
MoD Feltham will contribute significantly to housing delivery in the borough, helping to provide the genuinely affordable housing that Londoners desperately need and giving more people the security of a good quality home. In line with the MoD’s Forces First commitment, the development will also support the delivery of better-quality homes, ensuring Defence land continues to deliver lasting value for both the Armed Forces community and the wider public.
The new homes will be complemented by space for commercial and creative activities, creating a vibrant, well-connected neighbourhood with a new network of streets and transport connections linking the site with the surrounding area.
The MoD site is at the heart of Hounslow's Future Feltham masterplan, the Council's wider regeneration programme for the town. The programme represents around £950m of investment and has the potential to deliver around 3,000 new homes and 9,000 jobs in Feltham, with over 1,500 homes already delivered or in the pipeline.
Hounslow Council, the MoD, and the GLA have been working together since last October to prepare for the procurement launch. They are now looking for a development partner to work in partnership to deliver the site.
The procurement process is expected to complete in Summer 2027.The successful development partner will then prepare a masterplan and planning application before work starts on site – the expectation is that site clearance and enabling works could start from Spring 2028 onwards and a first phase of development will commence in 2029.
The War Department (predecessor to the MoD) first acquired the land during the First World War, and it has been in use ever since. The MoD is investing in military infrastructure that will allow the relocation of existing operations and the release of the site for housing delivery. The site adopted the trailblazer approach to development on public sector land that was announced last year, bringing together national, regional, and local government to accelerate housebuilding.
Cllr Shantanu Rajawat, Leader of Hounslow Council, said: “We are investing in Feltham to deliver new homes, jobs, skills, community spaces, and better connections. We want the benefits of that investment to be felt locally, through more genuinely affordable homes, good jobs, and opportunities for local people. Feltham MoD is at the heart of our plans and we’re looking for a developer to work with our trailblazing partnership to turn a closed-off site into a place that works for local people, Londoners, and supports our ambition for a fairer future for Hounslow.”
Catherine Davies, Head of Estates at Defence Infrastructure Organisation, said: “I’m very pleased to be working with Hounslow Council and Greater London Authority to promote the development of this important town centre site in Feltham. Three public authorities coming together with one vision offers a real opportunity for a creative outcome and we’re now looking for a development partner that can work with us to deliver that vision.”
Tom Copley, Deputy Mayor of London for Housing and Residential Development, said: “Feltham MoD is an opportunity to deliver much needed homes, as well as new jobs and community facilities for Londoners. This trailblazer project is an opportunity to show what can be achieved when central, regional, and local government work hand in hand with development partners to build a better, fairer, more prosperous London for everyone.”
Find out more about the plans for the MoD Feltham site and the wider Future Feltham programme at https://talk.hounslow.gov.uk/hub-page/future-feltham
Details of the procurement process and how to participate can be found at https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/Notice/102302-2026
